goal: The Historial de Pesaje dialog table fits inside the dialog with no annoying horizontal scroll.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Opening the Historial de Pesaje dialog shows the table with no horizontal overflow: the grid container scrollWidth <= clientWidth at default desktop viewport.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: open dialog, evaluate scrollWidth/clientWidth on the grid container; assert no overflow.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All columns (Periodo, Estado, Fecha, Duracion, Resumen, Acciones) and the action buttons are visible/within the dialog bounds; dialog is widened so sm:max-w-lg no longer caps it.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: assert action buttons' right edge is within the dialog content right edge.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm test + npm run lint + npx tsc -b all pass.

tasks.desc: Widen WeightingHistoryModal dialog (sm:max-w-3xl) so it overrides the dead sm:max-w-lg cap.
Make table columns fluid/robust: relax fixed widths, min-w-0 + truncate on text cells so it adapts on narrower viewports.
Add e2e regression test asserting the history table grid has no horizontal overflow.
